source_title: CTDOT Oversize/Overweight Permits — FAQ, Escort & Superload Matrix
verify_reasons: Legal limits, routine permit envelope, escort/State-Police matrix, superload definition and permit validity read from the official CTDOT OS/OW FAQ. The single-trip fee ($30, +$12 electronic) and annual formula ($9.00 per 1,000 lbs, +$5 electronic) are the long-standing CTDOT statutory fees but were not restated on the FAQ page fetched this run — confirm current fee schedule with the CTDOT OS/OW Permit Office (dot.osowpermits@ct.gov).

superload_thresholds.note: CTDOT superload = over 16' wide, over 16' high, over 150' long, or over 200,000 lbs gross. Superload moves are limited to nighttime only and typically require Connecticut State Police escorts; a certified Connecticut route survey (by a CT-based surveyor) within one week prior to the move date is required.

width.note: 1 escort over 12' wide — rear on divided highways, front on undivided (2 escorts on undivided)
front + rear civilian escorts plus State Police at/over 13'6" wide (CTDOT FAQ)
additional civilian escorts + State Police over ~15' (14'11") wide

height.note: 1 escort with height pole over 14' high; route survey required over 14'
State Police escort(s) over 15'1" high (CTDOT FAQ)

length.note: over 119'11": multiple escorts + State Police (CTDOT FAQ)

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip OS/OW permit = $30 (+$12 for electronic transmittal). Annual Indivisible-Load permit = $9.00 per 1,000 lbs (or fraction) of gross weight, +$5.00 for permits issued electronically (CTDOT fee schedule).
single_trip.note: Single-trip permit authorizes daylight movement over a 3-day period. Pilot cars must be at least 60" wide and no more than 1.5 ton capacity.

annual.note: Annual Indivisible-Load permit runs May 1–April 30; fee = $9.00 per 1,000 lbs gross (+$5 electronic). Radioactive-pharmaceutical permits run 6 months.

movement_restrictions: No moves during peak hours 6:30-9:00 a.m. or 4:00-6:00 p.m.
Loads 13'6" wide or over 14' high may travel only Tuesday through Thursday, 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
Superload moves limited to nighttime only, with Connecticut State Police escort and a certified CT route survey within one week of the move
Daylight movement otherwise for over-dimensional loads
notes: Legal limits: width 8'6", height 13'6", length 45' single unit (48' trailer w/ 43' kingpin, up to 53'), gross 80,000 lbs (36,000 2-axle single unit / 53,800 3-axle single unit).
Routine permit envelope: width 16', height 14' (route survey over 14'), length 130'. Escort/superload matrix from CTDOT OS/OW FAQ; fees from the CTDOT permit fee schedule.
